title: Windows System Administrator-L2
description:
**Job Title: Windows System Administrator – L2**

**Location:** Vadodara, Gujarat (On-Site)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

We are looking for an experienced Windows System Administrator – L2 with 3–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure and technical support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage and troubleshoot Windows Servers, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy.
* Provide L2 technical support and handle escalated incidents.
* Administer Microsoft 365, Azure, and basic AWS environments.
* Support networking, VPNs, firewalls, VMware/Hyper-V, backups, and disaster recovery.
* Perform server patching, security updates, and PowerShell automation.
* Maintain technical documentation and ensure SLA compliance.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong Windows Server administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, networking, and virtualization.
* Knowledge of PowerShell, backup solutions, and cloud technologies.
* Excellent English communication and customer-handling skills.

**Preferred:** MSP experience and international voice-based technical support experience.

Join our team to manage IT infrastructure and support global clients using diverse technologies.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: In person

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month
